name: marketing-campaign
description: Plan and produce marketing from natural-language requests for promotion, leads, reservations, orders, launches, content, ads, SEO or CRM (营销、推广、宣传、引流、获客). Select platform × industry × method and produce channel-native deliverables.

invocation_policy.semantic_trigger: the user requests broader marketing strategy, a multi-asset campaign, lead or reservation generation, ads, SEO, or CRM. For a single video from an open brief or approved script, including choosing its destination or adapting it to a platform, invoke video-production directly; it combines marketing-platform guidance as needed. Invoke marketing-campaign first only when the user also requests broader campaign planning or execution

examples: plan marketing campaign for new product
multi platform promotion plan for launch
how to promote my business online
